basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 5.' and it opens 'Vers. 5. Terror Dei invasit omnes per circuitum nationes. Ut promissionem suam Deus'. The printing's caput and the lemma's own words, matched against the Clementine, name the same chapter.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 5. Terror Dei invasit omnes per circuitum nationes. Ut promissionem suam Deus impleret, | quam ad Jacob habuerat, ideo divino terrore habitatores terrae illius perculit. Neque aliter per medium illarum nationum Jacob illaesus transire potuisset.
